Creative direction: Overall feel - Warm, tactile, summer-weight. The white primer stick against the warm brown coconut shell and bright coconut flesh creates natural contrast.


  • Clean minimal (white/cream BG with coconut pieces as styling)

  • Editorial (nude/light pink BG with coconut as a natural frame). 

Scope note: This is an addendum to the existing primer stick package.

Priority
V01 · Ingredient Video · Priority
Coconut nest reveal — slow push in
Primer stick standing upright inside the bowl of a fresh coconut half. Camera starts wide and slowly pushes in toward the product. The bright white coconut flesh frames the white primer naturally. Coconut milk or cream can pool around the base for richness. End frame: tight on the LYS logo. No sudden movement — slow, luxurious pace.

V02 · Ingredient Video · Optional
Coconut milk pour / splash around product
Product standing on a warm cream surface. Coconut milk poured or splashed around the base, creamy, indulgent, natural. The white formula of the primer echoes the colour of coconut milk visually. Can be captured as a slow-motion sequence.
